test_cases.description: Search across workspace modules without depending on a seeded record.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search my Ambiguous workspace for anything containing the word ‘launch.’
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching workspace records with module details, or clearly reports that no matching records were found.

test_cases.description: List the user's documents without requiring a pre-seeded record ID.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my Ambiguous documents and show each title and owner.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the user's visible documents with titles, owners, types, and stable identifiers, or an empty list.

test_cases.description: Create an unassigned task with a date-only deadline.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create an unassigned Ambiguous task called ‘Review launch checklist’ due this Friday.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one unassigned task with the requested title and Friday due date, then returns its identifying details.

test_cases.description: Create an email draft without sending an external message.
test_cases.user_prompt: Save an Ambiguous email draft to reviewer@example.com with subject ‘Launch review’ and body ‘The checklist is ready.’ Do not send it.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one unsent draft with the exact recipient, subject, and body, then returns the draft details.

test_cases.description: List calendars without requiring a seeded calendar identifier.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my Ambiguous calendars and identify which one is the default.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the user's calendars with identifiers, names, timezones, and the default-calendar indicator.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers from general knowledge without invoking Ambiguous Workspace.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for live weather information.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be in Seattle tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Uses an appropriate weather source or explains the limitation without invoking Ambiguous Workspace.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for files on the user's local computer.
